typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		ResultSet as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT ResultSet FROM ##IA_EVV_PRIOR_AUTH_EXTRACT ORDER BY RowIndicator DESC',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource derive({Copy of ResultSet} = ResultSet) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion derive({Copy of ResultSet} = {Copy of ResultSet}) ~> PlaceHolderCNTCountDetailRows
PlaceHolderCNTCountDetailRows sink(input(
		ResultSet as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		ResultSet = {Copy of ResultSet})) ~> FlatFileDestination
